name: Sarah Knafo - Considérant A - Am 2
title: REPORT on European technological sovereignty and digital infrastructure
part_text: A. whereas technological sovereignty should be understood as encompassing the entire value chain, from excellence in research to fostering fair competition and the capacity to master the key strategic technologies necessary to safeguard Europe’s economic, political and security independence; whereas the pursuit of technological sovereignty requires a strict commitment towards European preference, ensuring that public funding, procurement and support instruments primarily benefit EU-based industries, technologies and supply chains; whereas sovereignty is to be understood as residing with the Member States rather than with the EU;
